palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence that reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a very long palindrome:

```
Madam Arora teaches malayalam - Madam Arora teaches malayalam

Madam Arora teaches malayalam madam arora teaches malayalam, madam arora teaches malayalam, madam arora teaches malayalam, madam arora teaches malayalam, madam arora teaches malayalam, madam arora teaches malayalam, madam arora teaches malayalam, madam arora teaches malayalam, madam arora teaches malayalam

Madam Arora teaches malayalam - Madam Arora teaches malayalam
```

This palindrome is 257 characters long.
